page.overview:
Who is Andohar Noah?

Captain Andohar Noah was a character in Death on the Titan.

Andohar Noah was a captain of the Titan. Chief Jarrick Thorne died under suspiscious circumstances after a heated argument with the deckhand, Riko Marr. Noah searched Riko's locker and discovered a coded message from the intelligence division of House Atreides that was addressed to Thorne. He questioned Riko, told him that he had found the message and asked him to come clean. He warned him that the Spice Miner's Guild would allow the crew to kill him to satisfy their desire for vengeance over Thorne's death. Riko insisted that he knew nothing of the message and was being framed.

However, another crew member came forward and stated that he had seen Riko enter the shigawire hut on the night of Thorne's murder. Riko then admitted to taking the message, but denied killing Thorne. Noah demanded to know why Riko had taken the message and he replied that he had hoped it contained incriminating information about Thorne. Noah ordered Riko to place his hand flat on the table, plunging a knife into it once he did. Overcome with pain, Riko confessed to the murder, stating that Tessa Lim had put him up to it.
